flow.info-tooltip: Aggregation: last {days} days / denominator = turns where the center document appears. Bidirectional BFS — left (caller chain -3..-1) → center → right (callees 1..3, up to 3 hops). The rightmost "turn follow-up" column shows meta documents that appeared in the same turn after the center, without a call chain (dashed edges). Call frequency in 4 tiers — Frequent (≥50%) · Regular (20-50%) · Occasional (5-20%) · Rare (<5%).
flow.empty-hint: Flow is computed from recent turns. It appears once at least one turn has run in the selected scope.

hit-rate.title: Cache Hit Rate
hit-rate.desc:
Ratio of prompt-cache reads to total input tokens.
≥70%: green · 30–69%: orange · <30%: red.

ratio.title: Creation / Read Ratio
ratio.desc:
Write (initial creation) vs. Read (reuse) ratio of cache tokens.
stable: Read ≥ 70% — cache is being reused well.
building: Read < 70% — cache is still being populated.

burn-rate.title: Burn Rate · 24h
burn-rate.desc:
Cumulative token total for prompt requests over the last 24 hours.
· Large number: 24h accumulated input+output tokens
· ▲/▼ %: change vs. the same window yesterday
· sparkline: 24 hourly bars of token usage

cache-health.title: Cache Health · Prompt Cache
cache-health.desc:
Current hit ratio and 24h trend for the prompt cache.
· Large number: cache_read / (input + cache_read)
· Grade (●): ≥70% green / 30–69% blue / <30% amber
· Savings: accumulated input tokens reused via cache hits

live-pulse.title: Live Pulse · Real-time Activity
live-pulse.desc:
Current session activity status.
· Large text: timestamp of the most recent event (relative)
· ● n: number of active sessions (activity within the last 60s)
· sparkline: tool calls in a 5-minute window (Phase 2)

tool-categories.title: Tool Categories · Distribution
tool-categories.desc:
Category breakdown of tool calls over the last 24 hours.
· Agent : sub-agent calls (Task)
· Skill : skill invocations
· MCP   : external tool calls via MCP server
· Native: built-in tools (Read/Write/Bash/Edit, etc.)

cat-Agent.title: Agent
cat-Agent.desc:
Share of sub-agent calls via the Task tool.
Higher child tool call counts indicate deeper nesting.

cat-Skill.title: Skill
cat-Skill.desc:
Share of skill (SKILL.md) invocations.
Used to encapsulate domain knowledge and workflows.

cat-MCP.title: MCP
cat-MCP.desc:
Share of external tool calls via MCP servers.
Examples: playwright, context7, sequential-thinking.

cat-Native.title: Native
cat-Native.desc:
Share of Claude Code built-in tool calls.
Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob, etc.

anomaly.title: Anomaly · Detection
anomaly.desc:
Count of abnormal patterns in the last 24 hours.
· Tool error rate ≥5% (30-minute window)
· Same tool failed ≥3 times consecutively
· Sub-agent depth ≥3 or fan-out ≥5
· Turn tokens ≥ p95×2

context-growth.desc:
Shows the accumulated input_tokens flow during the session.
• Area below the line (dark) = usage, area above (light) = remaining limit.
• The limit is determined by the model_limits seed in the DB (Migration 026) — operators can update model mappings directly via SQL.
• Additional signals: a [1m] suffix in the model name or the context-1m-2025-08-07 token in the anthropic-beta header promotes the limit to 1M.
• This chart is based on proxy observations and may differ from actual usage after Claude's automatic compaction.
context-growth.title: Cumulative tokens

badge.spike: Token count exceeds 2× the session average
badge.loop: Same tool called 3 or more times consecutively

sessions.desc:
Number of Claude Code sessions created within the current filter period.
A session starts when the claude command is executed.
sessions.title: Total sessions

requests.desc:
Total count of prompt, tool_call, and system type requests.
Based on hook event receipts.
requests.title: Total requests

tokens.desc:
Sum of input and output tokens.
Includes cache_creation and cache_read tokens.
tokens.title: Total tokens

active.desc:
Number of sessions currently running in real time.
Based on ended_at NULL + activity within the last 30 minutes (storage/_shared.LIVE_STALE_THRESHOLD_MS).
Dot color: green = SSE connected, red = disconnected.
active.title: Live sessions

avg-duration.desc:
Average response time for prompt-type requests.
Includes LLM inference and network latency.
avg-duration.title: Avg response time

p95.desc:
95th percentile of tool_call response times.
Baseline excluding the slowest 5% of requests.
p95.title: P95 response time

err.desc:
Ratio of error responses among tool_call requests.
Displayed as a red warning when exceeding 5%.
err.title: Error rate

hooks.title: Hook Setup
hooks.profile-sub: Pick a profile and click [Apply now] once. Your file is backed up first and can be restored anytime via [Restore previous settings].

full.label: Recommended (Full)
full.desc: Track every Claude Code lifecycle event for the richest visualizations and analytics.
full.tooltip: Registers all 27 events: Pre/Post/SessionStart/Stop/SubagentStart/SubagentStop/PreCompact/PostCompact, etc. Best for users who want maximum analysis fidelity.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.desc: Register only 6 core events for minimum performance and disk overhead.
minimal.tooltip: Registers only UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart/SessionEnd/Stop. Lightest impact on Claude Code responsiveness and disk usage.

primary.desc: Turn on the high-speed graph engine to visualize Claude Code's complex traces in real time.
primary.tooltip: Uses the Ladybug graph engine as the primary response source. Complex BFS/sequential queries run fast.

proxy.title: Auto-register proxy
proxy.intro: Auto-install a conditional function in your shell profile that routes through spyglass only when it is LISTENING.
proxy.outro: Manual install: paste the snippet above into your shell profile (e.g. ~/.zshrc) and open a new shell.
proxy.action-help: Click [Auto-install proxy] above to actually modify the shell profile. Selecting a card alone does not install anything.
proxy.marker-explain-body: spyglass demarcates *its own region* inside your shell profile (e.g. ~/.zshrc) with two comment lines. Only the content between these two lines is managed by spyglass — your other code (export PATH, aliases, etc.) is never touched. nvm/conda use the same pattern. Click [Auto-install proxy] to inject the two lines automatically.

auto.label: Auto-detect (recommended)
auto.desc: Probe SHELL env and your home directory to pick the most appropriate shell profile.
auto.tooltip: Detection priority: process.env.SHELL → ~/.zshrc → ~/.bashrc → ~/.config/fish/config.fish. Recommended for most users.

zsh.label: zsh (~/.zshrc)
zsh.desc: macOS default shell. Writes directly to ~/.zshrc.
zsh.tooltip: Default shell since macOS Catalina. ~/.zshrc is created if missing.

bash.label: bash (~/.bashrc)
bash.desc: Linux default shell. Writes directly to ~/.bashrc.
bash.tooltip: Recommended for Linux / WSL. On macOS you may also need to source ~/.bash_profile.

fish.label: fish (~/.config/fish/config.fish)
fish.desc: For fish shell users. Uses function ... end syntax.
fish.tooltip: fish syntax differs from sh/bash, so it gets a dedicated branch. ~/.config/fish/config.fish is created if missing.
